name: ylspec
description: YLSpec language support with C-backed validation, syntax highlighting, completions, and optional formatting

ylspec.completion.enabled.description: Suggest table paths, reserved metadata keys, known profile values, booleans, and TOML value templates.

ylspec.completion.autoShow.description: Open suggestions when a single cursor enters an empty table header or array. Disable to use typing triggers and manual completion only.

ylspec.completion.profiles.description: Additional profile identifiers to suggest alongside core.data. Suggestions do not register validators or approve profile compatibility.

ylspec.validation.enabled.description: Validate YLSpec documents after edits and saves using the bundled C core.

ylspec.validation.delay.description: Delay in milliseconds before validating an edited document.

ylspec.maxDocumentBytes.description: Maximum UTF-8 document size sent to the validation worker.

ylspec.maxDepth.description: Maximum value depth, counting edges from the document root.

ylspec.format.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable semantic formatting through the C serializer. **Formatting removes comments and changes whitespace.** Disabled by default; enable only when that behavior is acceptable.
